# WebDAV

![CRAN_Status_Badge](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/webdav)  
![CRAN Downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/webdav)
  ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-darkviolet.svg) 
![Devel
Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/devel%20version-0.1.6-blue.svg)

WebDAV (*Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning*) is an extension of
the HTTP protocol that allows users to collaboratively edit and manage
files stored on remote web servers. It provides a framework for users to
create, delete, copy, move, and download files.

### Examples of WebDAV Servers

Some platforms that implement WebDAV are:

1.  **OwnCloud**: A popular open-source platform for storing and sharing
    files, commonly used by organizations.
2.  **NextCloud**: A fork of OwnCloud that focuses on user-friendly
    interfaces and collaborative file-sharing features.
3.  **mod_dav** for Apache HTTP servers: Adds WebDAV support to the
    Apache web server.
4.  **Microsoft SharePoint**: Uses WebDAV for file management over the
    web.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`handle_response()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/handle_response.md)
  : Handle HTTP response from Server
- [`webdav_copy_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_copy_file.md)
  : Copy a resource on the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_create_directory()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_create_directory.md)
  : Create a collection (directory) on a WebDAV server
- [`webdav_create_request()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_create_request.md)
  : Create a request for the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_delete_resource()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_delete_resource.md)
  : Delete a file or directory from the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_download_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_download_file.md)
  : Download a file from the WebDAV server
- [`webdav_list_files()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_list_files.md)
  : List files from a specific folder on WebDAV server
- [`webdav_upload_file()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/webdav/reference/webdav_upload_file.md)
  : Upload a file to the WebDAV server
